prompt: People in many countries now depend heavily on their smartphones. Why has this happened? What effects does this dependence have on individuals and on society?
essay:
In the modern world, almost everybody has a smartphone and many people can not live without it. There are some reasons for this situation and it also has good and bad effects on the people and on the society.

The main reason is that the smartphone can do everything. Before, we needed a camera for taking photos, a map for finding the way, a radio for listening the music and a computer for the email. Now all of these things are inside one small device which we can put in our pocket. Also, the price of the smartphones became cheaper and the internet is faster than before, so even the people who have not much money can buy one. Another reason is the social media. All our friends are on these applications, so if we do not use the phone we will lose the contact with them and we will not know what is happening.

About the effects, there are positive and negative. The positive effect is that we can communicate very easy and we can find any information in one second. The negative effect is that many people spend too much time on the phone and they do not talk with their family. Some students also can not concentrate on their study because they check the phone every five minutes.

In conclusion, people depend on the smartphone because it is useful and cheap and because of the social media, and this dependence has both good and bad effects on our life.
title: Why smartphones became impossible to give up
